reading.title: A Job at the Café
reading.text: Last spring my older sister Dilya applied for a job at a small café near our house. She wrote a short letter and went to an interview the next day. The owner liked her and offered her a part-time job on weekends. It is not a well-paid job, but she says she enjoys it. She does a good job, and customers often thank her for her smile. Her friend Aziz lost his job at a shop, so he is looking for a new one now. Dilya told him about a job vacancy at the café, and he has already sent his letter.

reading.text: My uncle Rustam started his career as a bus driver twenty years ago. He worked hard and learned to repair engines too. Slowly he climbed the career ladder and became the manager of the whole depot. Last year he decided on a career change. He now teaches young people how to drive and keep cars safe.
